name: database_query
description:
Runs a bounded, read-only SELECT or EXPLAIN SELECT query against a local SQLite database. It rejects write statements, multiple statements, PRAGMA, ATTACH, and transaction commands; connections are query-only.
Use when: inspecting data after database_inspect has identified the relevant schema.
Scope: local SQLite files only. Read-only; returns at most 500 rows and stops long-running queries.
Not for: schema changes, inserts, updates, deletes, remote databases, or arbitrary SQL scripts.

path.description: Path to a local SQLite database file.

query.description: One SELECT statement or EXPLAIN SELECT statement. Do not include a trailing semicolon.
